# Garth Marenghi's Darkplace

2004 - Fantasy/Humor
Cult comedy written by and starring Matthew Holness and Richard Ayoade. Presented as a 1980's lost classic, Darkplace revolves around fictional horror author Garth Marenghi and his publisher Dean Learner. A maverick doctor battles with the evil forces lurking beneath a hospital in Romford, engaged in a desperate struggle against poor production values, awful dialogue and unrealistic violence...
